why_blocked.core: G1 is real and reproduced at runtime, but it cannot be closed in-process without a caller-forgeable self-hash, which the commission forbids as a trust root.
why_blocked.detail: The F8 ingress receives  from the caller. Any binding computed in the same process over caller-held material is recomputable by that same caller. The accepted owners are ordinary mutable Python modules with no sealed producer identity and no independently administered principal at runtime. A new adapter would therefore re-wrap caller-supplied evidence behind a digest the caller can regenerate -- producing a green test and false assurance.
why_blocked.what_would_have_been_delivered_if_unbloc: an ingress module plus a q1/q2 competent positive court and the four hostile cases. Those are deliberately NOT banked, because demonstrating them over unbound synthetic evidence would imply an authenticated serving path that does not exist.

exact_minimal_precondition: An immutable producer-origin binding for PossibilitySliceEvidence: a sealed owner that mints the slice, holds its authority/provenance custody, and is neither reachable by nor recomputable from the caller.
The F8 ingress must accept only owner-minted evidence, and the owner identity must be carried into the result identity so that substituting authority_refs or provenance_refs changes result_hash.
A trusted reference for that owner identity that is independent of the caller. Without it, no digest over caller-held material is evidence of origin.
